name: Jesus Ramon Portillo
role: Senior SDET · QA Lead · Release Manager
description: Jesus Ramon Portillo — Senior SDET, QA Lead and Release Manager with 8+ years in test automation, quality engineering, CI/CD and mobile platforms.
summary: SDET leader with a strong engineering mindset and **8+ years of experience** across test automation, quality engineering, quality strategy, CI/CD, developer tooling, mobile and web platforms, and release management.

Experienced in leading QA teams, driving quality initiatives across multiple engineering teams, improving SDLC processes, and building scalable automation and internal tools. Strong background in cross-functional collaboration, stakeholder management, incident management, and complex software releases, with a focus on balancing product quality, engineering efficiency, and delivery speed.

More recently, the work has expanded into **AI-assisted software development**, focusing on quality practices, responsible AI usage, and establishing guidelines and policies for the effective use of AI tools to improve code quality and engineering / testing productivity.

experience.title: Senior SDET / QA Lead / Release Manager

Led the quality strategy for mobile applications while coordinating complex integrations and dependencies across 10+ engineering teams and leading a team of 5 test engineers. Later transitioned into the Release Manager role, taking ownership of release processes and cross-functional coordination across engineering and product teams.

Designed and maintained CI/CD pipelines and internal engineering tools to improve testing efficiency and developer experience.

Managed software release processes, coordinating validation, risk assessment, deployment readiness, and cross-functional communication.

Partnered with engineering, product, data, and other technical and non-technical stakeholders to identify and mitigate quality risks.

Designed multiple AI-assisted QA flows for test engineers and helped non-dev teams adopt and use AI tools to improve their workflows.
